title: Brute Force: Password Guessing (Web Application Login)
mitre_source: Borisenko et al. (2022), DOI: 10.1109/SYNCHROINFO55067.2022.9840920, Table II
source_note: observed_features: top-5 mean |SHAP| over the training reference set of the named Layer 1 variant. Not shown to the model by default.
description: Adversaries may attempt to gain access to a web application by systematically trying many username/password combinations against its login form, without knowledge of valid credentials.

network_indicators.traffic_pattern: Repeated HTTP POST requests to a login endpoint with varying credential payloads, from a single or small set of source IPs.

mitigation.name: Account Use Policies
mitigation.action: Implement account lockout or rate-limiting after repeated failed login attempts.

mitigation.name: Multi-factor Authentication
mitigation.action: Require MFA on web application login to reduce the impact of guessed credentials.

false_positive_hints: Load-testing tools or misconfigured client applications retrying failed logins can resemble brute force traffic.
